_comment: Works-in harness images (marketplace v2 section 7.4). One image per tool in sessionfs.skills.works_in_harness.TOOL_PLANS that has installer steps. Each included tool is installed from tools/<tool>/package-lock.json (npm ci, integrity-checked) at the exact version below. Bump the version here AND in tools/<tool>/package.json, then regenerate the lockfile with `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` in that directory. tests/unit/test_harness_images.py keeps all of this consistent.

claude-code.scripts_reason: the package's postinstall (install.cjs) links the platform binary from its optional dependency; it makes no network calls
claude-code.prune_reason: postinstall copies the platform binary into bin/claude.exe; the platform packages (and the musl builds npm also installs on glibc) are duplicates

copilot.prune_reason: npm-loader.js only picks the linuxmusl package on a non-glibc system; the image is glibc (Debian)

gemini.scripts_reason: skipped: only the optional native keytar / node-pty builds run scripts, and the installer path does not need them

excluded.antigravity: The only documented Linux install is https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh, which always installs the latest build from the vendor's manifest (no version argument or variable) and the binary self-updates; an exact version cannot be pinned, and redistribution terms in an image are unconfirmed (checked 2026-10-21: https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins?tab=cli).
excluded.codex: TOOL_PLANS marks it skipped: no documented non-interactive plugin install command, so an image would only ever report 'skipped'.
excluded.cursor: TOOL_PLANS marks it skipped: team marketplaces are imported in the Cursor dashboard, there is no installer CLI.
